title: School uniform database
body: A uniform shop keeps a database with two relations. UNIFORM(UCode, UName, UColor) has UCode as its primary key and UName defined as NOT NULL. Its tuples are: (1, Shirt, White), (2, Pant, Grey), (3, Skirt, Grey), (4, Tie, Blue), (5, Socks, Blue) and (6, Belt, Blue). COST(UCode, Size, Price) has {UCode, Size} as its composite primary key, the constraint Price > 0, and UCode as a foreign key that refers to UCode in UNIFORM. Among its tuples are (4, S, 150), (4, L, 170), (5, S, 180), (5, L, 210), (6, M, 110), (6, L, 140) and (6, XL, 160).
